rules: All facts are filtered to one current immutable publication through PostgreSQL views.
Use PostsPublished only from FactPostPeriod; hashtag/pair support are associations and do not sum to distinct Posts.
Use separate published-date and observed-date dimensions.
Review label source and null policy before adding Topic measures.
evidenceMaturity: Draft based on passed G06 and local PostgreSQL verification
datePolicy: published_date and observed_date are local Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh dates; observed_at_utc and published_at_utc remain UTC instants
nullPolicy: Preserve null interaction metrics; do not replace null with zero
topicPolicy: topic_* are empty pending reviewed Post labels; creator_category and DL4J clusters are not Topic labels
